description: Fibre optique Rennes Métropole : sites raccordés is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.rennesmetropole.fr. This layer of points locates the sites connected by a fibre optic cable of the metropolitan optical network. These sites can be NROs (optical connection nodes), POPs (operator points of presence), NRAs (ADSL subscriber connection nodes), administrations, companies or operator equipment. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Rennes Métropole optical fibre: connected sites" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2021-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
